description.name: RapidGateway (PKR)
description.tagline: Accept cards, mobile wallets (JazzCash, EasyPaisa), bank transfer and Raast payments in PKR via OAuth2-backed RapidGateway.
description.long: Official WHMCS Payment Gateway Module for RapidGateway. Features automatic token authentication, hosted checkout redirect, signed HMAC-SHA256 webhook callback verification, and automated invoice reconciliation.
features: Signed webhook notifications (HMAC-SHA256) with 5-minute replay prevention
Refunds API integration from WHMCS Admin
